summary.description: One sentence: what happens in the video.

hook.description: Verbatim spoken line and/or on-screen text in the first 3 seconds.

transcript.description: Verbatim spoken words in order. null if no speech.

on_screen_text.description: Every distinct text overlay, verbatim, in order.

format.description: 2-4 words, lowercase noun phrase, for how the video is constructed - not what it is about. Examples: 'voiceover product demo', 'green screen reaction', 'silent before after', 'unboxing haul'.

format_traits.description: 0-3 further 1-3 word lowercase traits. Examples: 'fast cuts', 'trending audio', 'text only', 'asmr', 'split screen', 'single take'.

setting.description: 2-4 words, lowercase noun phrase. Examples: 'kitchen counter', 'dog park', 'vet waiting room'.

topics.description: 2-5 subjects of the video, each a 2-4 word lowercase noun phrase.

products.description: Physical products shown or named. Empty if none.

name.description: 2-4 words, lowercase noun phrase for the object itself, no brand. Examples: 'ceramic slow feeder bowl', 'silicone lick mat'.

brand.description: Only if legible on screen or spoken aloud. Never inferred.

people.description: Named people mentioned or shown, verbatim. Not the creator unless named.

brands.description: Brands named aloud or legible on screen, verbatim.

places.description: Cities, countries, regions, or venues named or clearly shown by signage, verbatim.

organizations.description: Companies, clinics, shelters, retailers named, verbatim.

spoken_language.description: BCP-47 code of the speech, e.g. 'en', 'es'. null if no speech.

cta.description: 'tag_someone' covers 'tag your person', 'send this to him'.
